artworks.title: Temple of Confucius, Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a high-angle view of a traditional East Asian architectural structure. The composition is filled with a wooden building featuring layered, tiled roofs adorned with intricate carvings. The structure has several ornate roofs stacked upon each other. The image is monochrome, likely an early photograph with a sepia-toned palette. The surrounding buildings also have traditional tiled roofs, and in the distance, there are silhouettes of similar structures and some trees. The scene is well-lit, highlighting the detailed craftsmanship of the wooden elements.

artworks.title: Interior and Arches of the Temple of Heaven Where the Emperor Sacrifices Once a Year, in the Chinese City of Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a traditional Chinese architectural complex. A treeline obscures the horizon and separates the sky from the buildings below. A stone balustrade leads to rectangular gateways, attracting attention towards a tiered-roof pavilion. The architecture features intricate carvings. The color palette is sepia, enhancing the aged feel. In the distance, more structures and trees surround the main pavilion.

artworks.title: Sacred Temple of Heaven Where the Emperor Sacrifices Once a Year, in the Chinese City of Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This image depicts a traditional Asian temple with multiple tiered roofs. The building features three levels of circular roofs with ornate tile work and intricate carvings. The temple is elevated on a square stone platform with a staircase leading up to the entrance, which is adorned with detailed patterns. The structure is surrounded by well-kept grass.

artworks.title: Temple of Heaven from the Place Where the Priests Are Burnt, in the Chinese City of Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a classical Chinese architectural structure. The point of view appears to be level with the buildings. The buildings dominate the upper half of the frame. The closest structure features an ornate roof with intricate, upturned eaves adorned with symbolic ridge ornaments on the left side. Further back, a building with a series of circular, tiered roofs stands out on the right side, displaying detailed patterns and decorative friezes. Trees are visible in the distance at the base of the structures. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image a historical, monochromatic effect that highlights the architectural details.

artworks.title: Thibetan Monument in the Lama Temple, Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of an intricate stone structure resembling East Asian pagodas. It is surrounded by tall trees on both sides. The structure has ornate architectural details, including carvings and layered roofs with upward-curving edges. The color palette is primarily sepia, with rich browns and beiges contrasting against the stonework and shaded areas. The image captures the textures of stone carving and greenery, blending artistry and nature.

artworks.title: Mosque Near Pekin Occupied by the Commander-in-Chief and Lord Elgin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a traditional Asian architectural structure, potentially a temple or pavilion. The ornate roof has intricate, curved tiles and decorative figures along the ridges. A cart with a rounded canopy is positioned to the left of the building. Two individuals are nearby, one seated on the grass and another standing, leaning against the building's wall. Tall trees are visible in the distance against the sky. The color palette consists of sepia tones, giving the image an antique, monochromatic appearance.

artworks.title: Shops and Street, Chinese City of Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with an ornate architectural facade. The perspective is from street level, looking directly at the building. The building has detailed latticework, carvings, and dragon-like sculptures. The color palette is sepia. In the foreground, two people are seated, partially in shadows. The street continues with similar architectural features in the distance. The image captures fine details typical of early photography.

artworks.title: View of the Summer Palace Yuen Min Yuen, Pekin, Showing the Pagoda Before the Burning, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an ornate pagoda dominating the right side of the scene. In the background, there are low mountains, gently sloping towards the horizon. The color palette is muted and sepia-toned, giving a historical feel. The pagoda's intricate architecture is visible, with decorative layers contrasting with the blurry foliage in the foreground. Modest buildings are scattered amongst trees in the distance.

artworks.title: The Great Imperial Palace Yuen Min Yuen, Pekin, Before the Burning, October 18, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a traditional Chinese pavilion with intricate design. The perspective is slightly elevated, revealing the building's ornate architecture. Trees frame the structure and add depth to the composition. The pavilion features layered rooflines and detailed woodwork. The color palette is monochromatic. Trees in the foreground partially obscure the pavilion, while more trees in the background suggest a garden setting. The sky is overcast.

artworks.title: The Great Imperial Porcelain Palace Yuen Min Yuen, Pekin, October 18, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a traditional Chinese building. The image shows an ornate, multi-tiered structure with intricate architectural details against a backdrop of trees. The building's roof has an elaborate design, typical of traditional Chinese architecture, with upturned eaves adorned with decorative tile work. The facade of the building is richly decorated with elaborate carvings or reliefs, and there are several arched windows or openings, symmetrically placed. The surrounding vegetation, including trees and shrubs, frames the structure.

artworks.title: Imperial Summer Palace Yuen Min Yuen, Pekin, Before the Burning, October 18, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a multi-tiered pagoda structure. The camera is slightly below and to the side of the pagoda, capturing the architecture's height and design. The horizon is obscured by the pagoda and trees on the left. The pagoda has intricate details, including ornate eaves and balconies. It sits on a stone base atop a paved surface. Nearby, there is vegetation transitioning from cultivated grounds to a natural setting. The color palette is primarily sepia, emphasizing the stonework and wooden elements of the pagoda.

artworks.title: Exterior of the Tomb Depot Near Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate gate structure viewed from the front. The gate features intricate carvings and statues of mythical creatures on top. It is decorated with relief carvings of animals. The color palette is primarily sepia, emphasizing the architectural details. Trees can be seen beyond the gate through the open doorway.

artworks.title: Tomb Near Palichian, the Scene of the Commencement of the Attack on September 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image displays a traditional architectural gate surrounded by trees. The gate is adorned with decorative elements and statues. A pathway lined with trees leads towards the gate. The image has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage look.

artworks.title: Bridge of Palichian Near Pekin, the Scene of the Fight with Imperial Chinese Troops, September 21, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image displays a stone bridge extending across the scene. The horizon is high, sloping upwards towards tree-lined areas. The bridge has an arch and detailed stonework, with vertical posts on its sides. The ground near us is bare with patches of grass, leading to water under the bridge. The color palette is muted, resembling sepia tones. In the background, there are trees contrasting against the sky.

artworks.title: Architectural View of the Lama Temple Near Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The sculpture features seated Buddhas within an ornate structure. The figures are surrounded by an intricate relief on a circular stone stupa. The sculpture is a natural stone color with carved decorations, including geometric patterns and seated Buddhas. The perspective of the image is looking up at the structure, showcasing its grandeur and intricate detailing. The craftsmanship of the carvings suggests historical and cultural significance.

artworks.title: Arch in the Lama Temple Near Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image features a traditional Chinese architectural structure photographed from a low angle, showcasing intricate carvings and detailing. The structure is set against a background of trees, creating a contrast between light and shadow. Stone foundations and carvings in the foreground lead the eye upwards towards the ornate roof. The image has a sepia tone, highlighting the texture and details of the carvings.

artworks.title: Part of the Entrance to the Lama Temple Near Pekin, October 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a stone gateway with intricate carvings viewed from a low angle. The roof tiles are also intricately carved. A stone pathway leads to the gateway, with carved stone lions on plinths. The structure is adorned with patterns and Chinese script. The image has a warm, sepia tone. Trees and other structures are partially visible in the distance beyond the gate, with shadows accentuating the carvings.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Treasury, Canton, April 10, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate gate with detailed carvings and a tiered, tiled roof. The view is from a position slightly lower than the gate, looking straight ahead. In the distance, a traditional building is visible. The color palette is sepia-toned with shades of brown and cream. Two people are near the gate—one standing and the other sitting. A path leads through the gate, with more structures and a lone figure visible in the distance, framed by trees on either side.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Five Genii Temple, Canton, April 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image displays a traditional architectural structure. The roofs are decorated with intricate carvings and ornamental details, including dragon-like figures. The building dominates the frame, with a paved pathway leading to the entrance. Two figures stand at the foot of the steps, and in the distance, more steps lead into the structure where a person is seated. The color palette is sepia-toned, contrasting with the surroundings.

artworks.title: Interior of Pehtang Fort Showing the Magazine and Wooden Gun, August 1, 1860
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a scene dominated by military and construction equipment. There are cannonballs and rope on the ground, alongside a large cannon with detailed wheels. To the right, there is a stack of coiled ropes, and a man leaning against a pole. On the left, a few men are seated near a brick building with a tiled roof. A brick wall with a ladder rests against it. The background implies a horizon with a mostly featureless sky. The color palette is muted sepia, emphasizing the textures of the materials. The image is a photograph capturing the sharp details of the scene.

artworks.title: Workers on Girders of Auditorium, New Paris Opera
artworks.artist: Hyacinthe César Delmaet and Louis-Émile Durandelle
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an industrial construction scene. The image shows a structure of scaffolding and iron beams at a construction site. Details like beams, metal rails, and columns are visible, along with wooden scaffolding. The presence of light and shadows creates contrasts and textures on the metal surfaces.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brush and brown wash and white heightening over traces of graphite on brown prepared paper, laid down on an eighteenth-century mount
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a complex scene with elements of the divine and mortal realms. The image is filled with various figures and actions across celestial beings above and human figures below, depicted in a linear style suggestive of a narrative composition. In the upper section, angelic figures and ethereal beings are seen amidst clouds. They appear poised in postures that convey communication, exaltation, or proclamation. Below, there is a dynamic portrayal of human figures engaged in interactions or expressive gestures. The architecture suggests a grand temple or cityscape with archways and a bridge. Detailed figures in dramatic poses are also visible in the lower part of the image. Intricate lines and shading create movement and depth, and the monochrome palette emphasizes contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Panorama of Sebastopol No. 1
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image features an elevated view overlooking a vast landscape that extends into the distance. The skyline is marked by the sea with small silhouettes of ships visible. Remnants of stone structures are scattered across a barren terrain, leading to a more densely built-up area with large rectangular buildings. The urban area beyond becomes increasingly dense in the distance. The color palette is primarily sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Distant View of the Arsenal
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with clustered buildings viewed from above. There is a body of water surrounded by landforms and a long structure resembling arches or colonnades. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones. Rocks, paths, and scattered materials are in the foreground, leading to a densely populated area. Low structures fill the mid-ground, leading towards the water and sky.
